messages:
sara: FYI customer (AcmeRetail) escalated — their rerank endpoint returns very large negative scores and they expected probabilities. They pasted example: scores are like [-12.3, -8.1, -123.4, -0.5]. Any quick guidance? @alex :thinking:

alex: short answer: those look like raw logits, not normalized probs. Does their client expect probs? Ask for the original request/flags.

sara: they sent this sanitized request body:
```json
{
  \"model\": \"rwd-rerank-v1\",
  \"inputs\": [
    {
      \"query\": \"best running shoes for trail\",
      \"documents\": [\"doc1\", \"doc2\", \"doc3\", \"doc4\", \"doc5\" /* 50 total */]
    }
  ],
  \"options\": {
    \"batch_size\": 50,
    \"padding\": \"max\",
    \"return_logits\": true
  }
}
```

mike: two quick possibilities: 1) the API returns unnormalized scores by design (logits) unless you ask for probabilities, 2) client-side batching/padding can change the context and scoring. Also if they set `return_logits: true` they're explicitly asking for raw values.

jordan: can we confirm our API docs? I remember a field `return_probs` wasn't always available. infra-bot: docs_v2_reference/rerank -> scoring: returns unnormalized logit-like scores by default; use client-side softmax to convert, or set `normalize_scores:true` in SDK v0.8+ to get probabilities.

sara: customer says they never saw negative numbers before — they upgraded SDK last week. Could SDK default have changed?

alex: possible. New SDK changed default for `normalize_scores` to false to avoid expensive extra ops. If they upgraded, they'd see raw logits.

mike: recommended support reply (short):  
\"We return unnormalized scores (logits) by default. To get probabilities either enable `normalize_scores` in SDK v0.8+ or apply softmax across the returned scores per query. Example transform: 
```py
import math
scores = [-12.3, -8.1, -123.4, -0.5]
exp = [math.exp(s) for s in scores]
probs = [e / sum(exp) for e in exp]
```
This will convert to positive probabilities that sum to 1.\"
(Also include their request_id and a single-query repro without padding so we can check infra logs.)

jordan: add repro steps to ticket: 1) call /v1/rerank with single document set (no padding), 2) set `return_logits:false` or `normalize_scores:true` in SDK, 3) share request_id + response sample + timestamp.

sara: pasted customer's raw response sample with headers:
```
Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d
model: rwd-rerank-v1
body: { scores: [-12.3, -8.1, -123.4, -0.5], docs_returned: 5 }
```

alex: next steps for CS: send the short guidance above and ask them to repro with SDK pinned to the prior version (if they can) or run the softmax locally. If they confirm behavior only after upgrade, escalate to eng-ml with: request_id, SDK version, model, batch_size=50, sample scores.

mike: potential infra note for eng-ml: extreme negative like -123 could indicate underflow scaling (quantized path selection) or a different normalization plane; include full model trace if they can reproduce.

sara: I'm going to reply to customer with the softmax snippet + repro checklist and request the request_id. Will flag eng if they repro with sanitized payload. Thanks all :thumbsup:

alex: also cc:prod-analytics if they need historical diffs on SDK defaults.

jordan: filing internal bug if customer reproduces — tag eng-ml + eng-runtime.

infra-bot: action logged -> case 98721 created, escalations: pending customer repro.
